title: Prime factors of fusion-category dimensions: weak group-theoreticity, rank and decomposition
authors: Sebastian Burciu, Jingcheng Dong and Sébastien Palcoux
summary: Develops prime-factor criteria for weak group-theoreticity and decomposition of fusion categories. V2 adds rank lower bounds for a non-pointed simple integral modular fusion category: 31 in general, 33 in nonsquare dimension, 57 in odd dimension, and 75 in odd nonsquare dimension.
